name: tools-multiple-midway-points-tool
title: Multiple Midway Points Tool
description:
Multiple Midway Points Tool (or short MMP) is a handler for, well, multiple midway points. That means, you can easily set the midway points settings without calculating the values on your own.
Furthermore, the patch is pretty inflexible when you want to change the total amount of midway points. This tool solves it by generating as many midway points as there are necessary.

More information in the readme.

Original Multiple Midway Points patch made by Kaijyuu with modifications made by me and lx5.
